newsitem.title: USA: 3NET says settles old issues with SEC.
newsitem.headline: 3NET says settles old issues with SEC.

text.p: 3Net Systems Inc said Thursday the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission and 3Net have settled outstanding issues without the company admitting or denying liability.
The settlement relates to allegations made by the SEC that prior management misrepresented the company's medical computer application systems and financial results as far back as 1992.
The prior management is no longer associated with 3Net, the company said.
3Net initially offered to settle in April 1995, and the SEC just recently accepted it, the company said.
